subject: PICTURE clause
notes: kb/Work PB490 LANDED. Rule 7's zero-suppression string absorbs every simple insertion editing symbol embedded in it or immediately right of it, from the ONE set: PIC ZZ/ZZ and PIC ZZ0ZZ MOVE 12 now render '   12' and PIC **/** MOVE 12 renders '***12' (rule 7 a) - the replacement character 'into any character position immediately preceding' the first nonzero numeric character). The membership test is new and is the other half of the fix: EMBEDDED or to the immediate RIGHT, never LEFT, so a leading simple insertion keeps its insertion character (PIC 0ZZ9 -> '0  1', PIC ,ZZ9 -> ',  1', PIC /ZZ9 -> '/  1'), which is what 13.18.40.4 GR15 requires from the VALIDATE side and what 13.18.40.6 Table 10 admits; the previous code blanked a leading ',' as well. 7 b) is unchanged and still pinned (PIC ZZ/ZZ MOVE 0 -> all spaces, PIC **/** MOVE 0 -> all asterisks). The 'PIC $***.** MOVE 0 -> ****.**' reading the adjudication recorded rather than charged is untouched and still conforms to 7 b)'s literal text.
